# Your non-game getaway to the beach! 
Stunning endless **real** 360˚ beaches from around the world. With gratitude meditations, music and mantras. 

The beach activates your parasympathetic nervous system to help you cope, find calm, focus and feel better. Gratitude blocks toxic emotions.

{420969384444386}

Choose “5 minute fix” for a quick combo of randomized beach, gratitude meditation and music to restore your nervous system. 

# Install now to take advantage of Early Access pricing.
{936364868347869}

# With Early Access you receive:

Solid app ready-to-use now.

5 Minute Fix: see what comes through today, just for you.

Full App (to date)

12 Stunning Beaches: St. Barts, France, Sweden, Turks & Caicos, Mexico, Hawaii.

20 Gratitude Meditations: 4-6 minute sessions designed to uplift your spirit.

**Beach Bag of Goodies:**

- 10 music tracks
- 400 mantras
- Volume controls
- Timer and stopwatch
- Inspirational quotes
- Interface on/off with "A" 

**Exciting Features Coming Up:**

Interactive chakra stones, candles, singing bowls, and beads

Further increased beach resolution

Location Mapping: Learn where you are on earth

Breath Animations: Visual cues to enhance your breathing exercises

Expanded Content:
More beaches, guides and meditations, music and short stories
ASMR, yoga, breath work, gratitude, sound healing

**Feel Better at the Beach!**

Send Early Access feedback to

gratitui.com/sayhello

(formerly working title PraiaVR)
